content.short: Orbofi AI provides an AI-generated content layer for Web3, games, and online communities.
content.description: Orbofi AI enables anyone with a phone to create AI-generated content, tokenize it on-chain, and build standalone AI models in just a few clicks for any type of digital material. The platform aims to democratize gaming and media asset creation on-chain, using AI to empower creators to monetize their work. By combining accessible AI tooling with blockchain tokenization, it lowers barriers for makers to publish, trade, and monetize AI-driven art, assets, and experiences.
